parameters.subject: 🎓 Your n8n M-Pesa Course access — one more step
parameters.html:
=

Hi {{ $('Parse Gumroad Payload').item.json.buyer_name || 'there' }},

Thanks for buying the {{ $('Parse Gumroad Payload').item.json.product_tier }} tier of the n8n M-Pesa Mastery course. Payment confirmed.

Your receipt / sale ID:
{{ $('Parse Gumroad Payload').item.json.provider_sale_id }}

To get lifetime access to the private Git repo (workflows, Postman collection, SQL schemas, deploy scripts, PDF handbook with updates), visit:

👉 {{ $env.COURSE_SITE_URL }}/repo-access.html

Enter your receipt + GitHub username and we'll invite you to the repo instantly.

If you don't have a GitHub account, you can still access the full handbook, Postman collection, and workflow JSONs from the download link in your Gumroad library.

Questions? Reply to this email.

— Course team

meta.description: Receives Gumroad sale webhook. Stores purchase. Emails buyer with a link to the repo-access form.
